requirements.intent: A server frame header is accepted only with the minimal length encoding: marker 0-125 is the length, marker 126 carries a 16-bit length of 126-65535 and marker 127 a 64-bit length of at least 65536 with the most significant bit 0. The extended length is read in network byte order, the header is 2, 4 or 10 bytes, and the accepted length is at most the configured limit and 0x7fffffff.
origin: Library policy: the configured frame size limit and the 0x7fffffff array bound (section 10.4 asks for a limit and sets no value)

clauses: ensures headerSize == (if (second & 127) <= 125 then 2 else if (second & 127) == 126 then 4 else 10)
ensures status == 0 <==> PrefixValid(first, second) && available < headerSize - 2
ensures status == 2 ==> HeaderValid(first, second, length, limit) && available >= headerSize - 2

ensures PrefixValid(first, second) && available >= headerSize - 2 ==> length == (if (second & 127) <= 125 then (second & 127) as bv64 else Word(extended[..headerSize as int - 2])) && (status == 2 <==> HeaderValid(first, second, length, limit))
requires count <= 8 && count as int <= bytes.Length

production_paths.responsibility: Pass the two prefix bytes, exactly the extended-length bytes read after them with their count, and the configured limit to Admit, which calls DecodeHeader; throw unless the status is 2.
